lure: A fraud alert about a payment you did not make
ask: Reply, then move your money to protect it

message.body: Chase fraud alert: did you send $1,250? Reply NO to stop it. Then send money to yourself to protect your account.

source.attribution: Prudence demo cases (Scam Shield), CC BY 4.0

verdict.headline: This is not Chase.
reasons: Chase never asks you to move money to protect it.
The number is not the bank's.
